title: Pop! Pop! Pop!
objectives_ko: 글자 A·B·C의 이름과 소리를 알고 말한다
A·B·C로 시작하는 단어 9개를 듣고 말하고 찾는다
사이트워드 I, see, a를 보고 읽는다

workbook.title: B. Circle the same letter.  C. Match and color.
D. Trace the words.  E. Color and say.
F. Read three times.  G. Sort the words.  H. Finish the story.

story.title: Pop! Pop! Pop!

panels.desc: Bun and Hedgie have just stepped through a small round wooden door into a sunny magical garden with a long row of empty clay flower pots. Pip hops excitedly beside a wicker basket of red apples, pointing at a single glowing golden seed inside the basket. Hidden in the picture: a toy astronaut sitting on a garden shelf, a weathervane shaped like an arrow on the shed roof.
panels.ko: 사과 바구니 속에 반짝이는 씨앗이 있어요. 번이 사과를 보고, 헤지가 /a/ 소리를 말해요.

panels.desc: In the same garden, a brand-new cheerful letter tree with red apples has just sprouted behind them. Bun points at a yellow toy school bus parked on the garden path with a glowing seed on its roof; Hedgie kneels beside it, amazed. Hidden in the picture: Hedgie's red school bag on the ground, a tiny doll bed among the flowers.
panels.ko: 사과나무가 펑 하고 자랐어요! 이번엔 버스 지붕에 씨앗이 있어요. /b/ /b/ 버스!

ask.en: What is new in the garden?

panels.desc: An orange tabby cat is curled up asleep inside a giant blue cup-shaped flower pot, with a glowing seed resting on its back. Hedgie tiptoes toward it with a finger on his lips; Bun holds Pip, who is glowing. Hidden in the picture: a striped candy in Hedgie's other hand.
panels.ko: 컵 모양 화분 속에서 고양이가 자고 있어요. 등에 씨앗이 있어요. 헤지가 살금살금 다가가요.

panels.desc: Three new cheerful letter trees stand in a row in the garden, each with a wooden sign on its trunk showing one big letter: the first tree's sign reads 'A' with a red apple, a toy astronaut and a toy arrow hanging from its branches; the second tree's sign reads 'B' with a yellow toy bus, a red backpack and a tiny doll bed hanging; the third tree's sign reads 'C' with an orange cat, a blue cup and a striped candy hanging. Bun and Hedgie stand in front of the trees, proudly pointing at them one after another; Pip flutters between them glowing with joy. In the foreground corner, Grumble, a grumpy old raccoon in a striped nightcap holding a tiny candle lantern, has just peeked out from behind a tree trunk with one paw at his mouth, and the friends glance at him in surprise. The three letters A, B and C on the signs are the ONLY text allowed in the picture.
panels.ko: A, B, C 나무 세 그루가 섰어요. 그런데 나무 뒤에서 너구리 할아버지가 "쉿!" 해요. 등불이 아주 작게 켜져 있어요.

story.synopsis_ko: 사과 바구니, 장난감 버스, 고양이 등에서 씨앗 세 개를 찾았어요. 친구들이 /a/ /b/ /k/ 소리를 말하자 펑! 글자나무가 자랐어요. 그런데 나무 뒤에서 "쉿!" 하는 소리가 났어요.
story.so_far_ko: 번과 헤지가 소리 정원에서 노래를 잃은 핍을 만났어요.
story.goal_ko: 씨앗 세 개를 찾아 소리를 말하고 A·B·C 나무를 키워요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the small round sprite hops up and down beside the apple basket, the golden seed in the basket twinkles and glows brighter, the rabbit and the hedgehog lean in with wonder, leaves sway softly in a warm breeze. Camera still. Soft, slow, child-friendly motion. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: the glowing seed on the toy bus roof sparkles, then with a soft POP a small cheerful letter tree sprouts up beside the bus and grows quickly, little yellow bus-shaped fruits swinging; the rabbit and the hedgehog cheer with arms raised. Camera still. Child-friendly, playful. No text.

pages.desc: Inside the Sound Garden. Pip hops excitedly beside a wicker basket of red apples and points at a single glowing golden seed inside; Bun points too with a big smile; Hedgie peeks over the basket edge. Hidden in the picture: a toy astronaut on a garden shelf, an arrow-shaped weathervane on the shed roof. Grumble does NOT appear.
pages.ko: 사과 바구니 속에 씨앗이 빛나요. 번이 가리키고 헤지가 /a/를 말하니 펑! 나무가 자랐어요.

pages.desc: A brand-new apple tree has sprouted. On the garden path a yellow toy school bus has a glowing seed on its roof; nearby an orange tabby cat sleeps inside a giant blue cup-shaped flower pot with a seed on its back. Bun shouts at the bus; Hedgie tiptoes toward the cat with a finger on his lips; Pip glows. Hidden in the picture: a red school bag, a tiny doll bed among the flowers, a striped candy in Hedgie's paw. Grumble does NOT appear.
pages.task: Find the b and c things!
pages.ko: 버스 지붕과 컵 화분 속 고양이 등에 씨앗이 있어요. /b/ /b/ 버스! /k/ /k/ 고양이! 펑펑!

pages.desc: Three new cheerful letter trees stand in a row with blank wooden signs on their trunks: one with apple, astronaut and arrow fruits, one with bus, bag and bed fruits, one with cat, cup and candy fruits. Bun and Hedgie cheer in front of them; Pip flutters between the trees glowing with joy. In the foreground corner, Grumble, the grumpy old raccoon in a striped nightcap, peeks out from behind a tree trunk with one paw at his mouth, holding a tiny candle lantern with a very small flickering flame.
pages.ko: 나무 세 그루가 섰어요. 나무 뒤에서 그럼블이 '쉿!' 해요. 등불은 아주 작은 불꽃이에요.
